changes.comment: Fix a regression where a bare specifier such as `@use '@scope/pkg/theme'` could not be resolved. Bare specifiers now fall back to the new `loadPaths` option and then to `node_modules` when they do not resolve relative to the importing file. Also apply the legacy `~` rewrite in constructs other than `@use`/`@import`/`@forward`, such as `meta.load-css()`.
